name: Surtshellir
note: Wikipedia point; the CHILL-ICE lunar-analog habitat campaigns used this system and the neighbouring Stefánshellir. The chill-ice entry in sites.json is 1.5 km from this point.

name: Umm Jirsan lava tube
note: Same point as sites.json, from Stewart et al. 2024, which studies it as a lava-tube analog for Moon and Mars.

name: Cueva de los Verdes
note: Part of the La Corona tube on Lanzarote; ESA mapped 1.3 km of it in 2017 (PANGAEA-X) as a model for Moon and Mars lava tubes.

name: Valentine Cave, Lava Beds
note: Cave where NASA Ames drove the CaveR rover in the BRAILLE project, practising cave exploration for Moon and Mars.

name: Lava Beds National Monument
note: Monument point, not a single tube; North America's largest lava-tube network and the home of NASA BRAILLE.
